collection.description: A child has been ill for many days; the healers disagree about whether an experimental remedy is worth its risks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child has been ill for many days; the healers disagree about whether an experimental remedy is worth its risks.

choices.label: Explain the uncertain treatment to the child's guardians
Invite another healer to review the case.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text:
Explain the uncertain treatment to the child's guardians and listen to the child where possible.
The remedy is given, and the child slowly improves.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text:
Explain the uncertain treatment to the child's guardians and listen to the child where possible.
The remedy causes distress and is stopped; the child remains ill.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child recovers and asks to return to play.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child grows weaker, and the family requests more help.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The new healer identifies a source of contaminated water.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healers remain uncertain and explain the limits of their knowledge.
